fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-08-29 at approximately 15:40, it was reported that the complainant discovered that a gas stove and utensils had been taken from a place near Selvapuram Puram Main Street in Vellore. Contact details given by the complainant, Sanjay Raj, include the number 9000000083. The complaint mentions Jeeva Natarajan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000002, in connection with the events. An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. Pavithra Bai (9000000006) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly entered through an unsecured entry point.
